The fashion show, held on Wednesday, November 4, at the new Yeezy flagship store, Droam 1, in Los Angeles, marked West’s first runway presentation since 2022.
Censori attended the event alongside the rapper’s children with his ex-wife, reality television star Kim Kardashian: North, 13, Saint, 10, Chicago, eight, and Psalm, seven.
The family posed for photographs at the event, with the three younger children dressed in coordinated Yeezy outfits in neutral shades, while West and North opted for black ensembles.
Censori also attracted attention in a form-fitting, plunging outfit paired with knee-high boots.
The show featured models walking around a large sculptural structure in an ivory-coloured space, departing from the conventional runway arrangement.
Several celebrities and music industry figures, including Kid Cudi, Big Sean, 2 Chainz and King Combs, were also among those in attendance.
The presentation marks a new chapter for West’s fashion brand following a four-year break from runway shows, with the rapper seeking to reintroduce Yeezy to the fashion scene.
